name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin (mono-red goblins, Bracket 4)
notes:
DeckCheck scan of https://deckcheck.co/app/decklist/5HDl38P7BFIN (creator MrLaier), CRISPI 7.44, Bracket 4. Numbers copied from the CRISPI panel, not inferred. Deliberately paired with krenko-mob-boss-goblins.json: same colour, same archetype, 6.00 vs 7.44, so the pair isolates power from colour and plan.

CONSISTENCY 5.25 - "Goblin-specific tutors like Goblin Recruiter and Goblin Matron, backed by card-draw engines like Skullclamp, Rundvelt Hordemaster, and Conspicuous Snoop. Low average mana curve minimises mana screw even with a lean land count."

RESILIENCE 9 - "redundant token creators like Krenko, Mob Boss and Squee, alongside graveyard recursion from Goblin Welder and Agatha's Soul Cauldron. Protection pieces like Deflecting Swat, Hexing Squelcher, and Goblin Chirurgeon shield key threats."

INTERACTION 8 - "the removal suite features 33 interactive pieces, including cheap burn, artifact destruction like Goblin Trashmaster and Siege Smash, and stack interaction like Deflecting Swat, Tibalt's Trickery, and Return the Favor."

SPEED 7.5 - band table maps Speed 7.5 to win turns 4-5. "Fast aggro-combo pace, aiming to win between turns 4 and 5."

Contains Valakut Awakening, a modal double-faced card, so this deck also exercises the front-face lookup bug in lib/scryfall.ts.
